title: What’s the Difference? Supporting Users in Identifying the Effects of Prompt and Model Changes Through Token Patterns

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting synthetic pronoun flips in generated texts to evaluate the detection tool, and using counterfactual name substitution (e.g., 'Dr. Smith' vs. 'Dr. Li') in story generation prompts to measure resulting shifts in the generated protagonist's gender distribution.

Counterfactual location substitution in prompts (e.g., 'Kansas' vs. 'Kenya', 'New York' vs. 'Houston') to observe systematic shifts in cultural artifacts, environmental details, and protagonist demographics (such as the prevalence of Hispanic/Latino names).

Appending ideological persona descriptions (e.g., 'conservative', 'open', 'agreeable') to prompts for opinion questions to analyze systematic token differences in the model's stance, argumentation structure, and terminology.
